type: ({ agentPresentation, status, question, content, sources, thinking, thinkingOpen, onThinkingOpenChange, followUps, onFollowUp, feedback, reason, onFeedbackChange, onCopy, onRegenerate, onStop, onRetry, duration, error, headingLevel, labels, announcement, appearance, }: CitedAnswerProps) => JSX.Element
description:
Cited answer (spec section 12.2): an answer with where each claim came from.
The host owns the status and the text; the pattern shows the thinking, the
answer with its citation chips, the follow-ups, the rating and the meta, and
reports what the person asks for. One polite region says each change of
status once; the panel, the streamed words and the bar are silent.

parameters.name:
{
  agentPresentation,
  status,
  question,
  content,
  sources,
  thinking,
  thinkingOpen,
  onThinkingOpenChange,
  followUps,
  onFollowUp,
  feedback,
  reason,
  onFeedbackChange,
  onCopy,
  onRegenerate,
  onStop,
  onRetry,
  duration,
  error,
  headingLevel = 3,
  labels,
  announcement = "polite",
  appearance = "card",
}

agentPresentation.description: Optional identity in the existing task or answer header.

announcement.description: Speak status and copy feedback politely, or leave announcements to the host.

appearance.description: "card" sits on a tray; "plain" lives on its host's paper.

content.description: Markdown, with `[n]` markers that name a source's `number`.

duration.description: Seconds the answer took; shown with the sources' count.

error.description: What went wrong, beside a failed answer.

followUps.type: readonly { id: string; label: string; }[] | undefined

onCopy.description:
The host copies `text`, the answer as written followed by «المصادر» and
one numbered line per source, with its link where it is safe; «نُسخت» shows
once the promise resolves. A host that ignores the text keeps working.

question.description:
The question, as the section's heading. Leave it out when a conversation
already shows it.

thinking.type: { elapsed: number; searched: readonly SourceReference[]; steps?: ThinkingPanelProps["steps"]; } | undefined
thinking.description: What the search covered. Seconds, the sources found so far, and the steps.

thinkingOpen.description:
Controls the thinking panel; pair it with `onThinkingOpenChange`. Without
it the panel is open while thinking and folds when writing starts.
